title: openIndu /dev data contract
description: Validates route.json's shape for the org-wide /dev pipeline (spec/005) and standing merge authorization (spec/006). Field semantics, issue terminal states and runner exit codes are documented here as the sole source — this file is spec/005 section 2.4 made machine-checkable. Runtime parameters live as data in route.json, never enumerated in runner code (see CLAUDE.md: the control layer does not enumerate concrete repos).

dev_grants.description: Standing merge authorizations (principle SKILL.md clause SA-1). Empty until spec/005 stage 9's grant PR. A repo not named in any entry's `repos`, including one created after the grant, does not inherit it. An expired, unreadable or revoked grant authorizes nothing.

repos.description: Keyed by repo id (route.json's existing per-repo entries). Each entry may carry an optional `dev` object; every `dev.*` field defaults as documented in $defs/devConfig when the key or the whole object is absent.

devGrant.description: One standing authorization entry, per principle SKILL.md RULE 5.2's SA-1 clause.

approved_by.description: The maintainer who approved it. Never an agent.

single_approver.description: true when the organization has a single maintainer and that person's own approval was sufficient alone (SA-1); an agent is never the approver, regardless of org size.

ref.description: The reviewed/CI-evaluated artifact this grant traces back to (spec, PR, or similar).

principle_ref.description: Commit SHA on control-tower's default branch whose principle/SKILL.md the grant was issued against. Read live at merge time; a failed read or a default-branch SKILL.md without the SA-1 marker means no merge (guard G12).

repos.description: Individually listed repo ids this grant covers. A repo not listed here does not inherit the grant.

devConfig.description: Per-repo /dev configuration. Every field below is optional; the listed default applies when the field, or the whole `dev` object, is absent.

enabled.description: Whether /dev may operate on this repo at all (PR-only counts as operating). Default false. Excluded repo types (control-tower, aggregate, gitops, fork, meta) may never be set to true.

default_branch.description: Baseline branch for CI/merge comparisons. Default: the repo's actual default branch.

checks.description: Local deterministic gate commands (format/lint/test), taken from this repo's own CI. Also the only Bash commands the implementer role may run. Default: none — local gating is left to CI.

required_checks.description: Human-declared required checks. Default: none, which forces admission guard A2 (PR-only, never auto-merged).

safety_paths.description: Device-safety paths (spec/005 section 2.3-2). A repo whose type is station/controller/vision/cim/studio, or whose delivery_owner is station-control, may not appear in any dev_grants entry until this is registered. Once registered, any change touching these paths always goes to human review.

protected_paths.description: Added on top of the runner's default protected-path list (never replaces it).

publishes_on_merge.description: Whether a push to the default branch publishes an artifact (image, package). Relevant to residual risk R3 — a merge cannot be unpublished by git revert alone.

commit.description: Attribution/DCO requirements for commits the runner makes in this repo. Default: no attribution line, no DCO sign-off required.

local_service.description: Step 5 (local build/boot) parameters. Default: absent, so step 5 is skipped and the run report says why. Property shapes added in spec/005 stage 7 PR-F6 -- previously this object had no properties sub-schema at all.

build_command.description: Run once in the verification worktree before start_command.

start_command.description: Started detached; step 5 does not block on it exiting.

health_check_url.description: Polled after start_command until it responds OK or a timeout elapses.

forbidden_env_patterns.description: Substrings/fragments that must not appear anywhere in the resolved local-service env (e.g. a production hostname or connection string). Any match refuses to start -- this is the 'not pointing at production' check, motivated by a real prior incident where a local stack connected to a remote production DB.

build.description: Step 6 (`./dev build`) entry point. For an aggregate submodule, points at the aggregate repo's own /release. A repo with no established image-publish pipeline is null.

issueTerminalState.description: Terminal state of a single issue processed by /dev. MERGED: merged under a standing authorization. PR_GREEN: a PR was opened, CI is green, awaiting human merge. HUMAN_MERGE_REQUIRED: a guard sent it to human review after review/CI work. HUMAN_REQUIRED: needs a human decision before any PR work. NEEDS_TRIAGE: ambiguous, needs scoping. NO_ACTION: correctly nothing to do (e.g. repo not enabled, excluded type). BLOCKED: stuck on an external dependency. FAILED: an internal error, not a safety refusal.

exitCode.description: Runner exit codes. 0: everything completed, every row's read-back passed. 1: argument or internal error. 2: partially completed (one or more BLOCKED/FAILED/HUMAN_* items). 3: refused outright — excluded repo type, dev.enabled is false, or admission guard A1 failed. 4: circuit breaker tripped, a pause marker was written. 5: environment check failed — one of section 2.6's positive controls did not come back clean; never run unattended, never auto-merge.
